review:
VERDICT goal: the node's goal is to carry each figure's revision on the index row the page paints from; reckon/metadata_index.py:1001 puts `revision` on every figure row and reckon/serve.py:2134 (_served_index_rows) serves those rows from /_index/<project>, with docs/ui/shell-plans.jsx:229 and docs/ui/plan.jsx:427 building the first-paint URLs from it.
VERDICT done_when: the done_when names three cases and a negative control; tests/test_a_figure_revision_is_fetched_once.py carries all three (first-paint row then immutable figure and thumbnail at 148-171, predating entry rebuilt at 174-211, non-renderable thumbnail one header at 214-228), logs/gate-pin.log records 18 passed EXIT=0 and logs/negative-control.log 2 failed EXIT=1.
VERDICT write_paths: read the source prompt's fence and the manifest's paths; every path in the diff is inside them, the one file beyond the original fence (tests/test_metadata_index_survives_restart.py) written under the coordinator extension recorded in the run's resume-1-advice.txt.
VERDICT manifest: read; status complete, commits c4f005bb5 and d362c8a04 recorded with changed paths, and the gate, negative-control and population arms named with log paths and EXIT= lines.
VERDICT diff: read commit by commit over 784c52439..d362c8a04, two commits and six files; c4f005bb5 adds file_revision to reckon/file_memo.py and calls it from metadata_index and serve, deletes serve._file_revision, and makes _send defer to a caller's Cache-Control; d362c8a04 adds `revision` to the served-row pin.

SCORE durability: 18
JUSTIFICATION durability: the added assertions compute the token independently via os.stat in _revision_of at tests/test_a_figure_revision_is_fetched_once.py:41 and the armed control reddens the first-paint and predating-entry cases, so restoring a dropped revision fails the gate.

JUSTIFICATION fit: file_revision at reckon/file_memo.py:283 follows that module's stat-identity idiom beside file_signature, and _row_is_complete's figure branch at reckon/metadata_index.py:466 extends the existing completeness rule with a mechanism comment.
SCORE reuse: 19
JUSTIFICATION reuse: the land moves the token to one owner, reckon/file_memo.py:file_revision, that the index (metadata_index.py:1001) and both routes (serve.py:3362, serve.py:3437) call, deleting serve._file_revision rather than forking it.
